articles.title: FBI Director's Promo Video Sparks AI Controversy with Beastie Boys Lookalike Clips
articles.summary: Kash Patel's FBI video used the Beastie Boys' 'Sabotage' and appears to have AI-generated clips nearly identical to the 1994 music video. Experts say AI errors like a telephone line through a character's head make it highly likely. The FBI hasn't responded.

articles.title: Microsoft, Google, xAI Open AI Models to U.S. Government for National Security Vetting
articles.summary: In a new agreement, Microsoft, Google, and xAI will give the U.S. government early access to frontier AI models for security testing. The deal addresses rising concerns that advanced AI could empower hackers or be weaponized, and follows a Pentagon pact for classified AI use.

articles.title: GOP Pushes $1 Billion for White House Ballroom Security After Assassination Attempt
articles.summary: Senate Republicans added $1 billion in Secret Service funding for Trump's East Wing ballroom project to an immigration bill, following a man's alleged assassination attempt at a White House correspondents' dinner. The money covers 'above-ground and below-ground security features' but not construction, which Trump says private funds will pay for.
